items.title: Automation paused after repeated failures: New Lead Notification
items.body_markdown: The circuit breaker paused **New Lead Notification** after 5 consecutive failed runs. The workflow will not process triggers until someone resumes it. Deliveries arriving in the meantime are stored, not run.

items.title: Preview container recycled overnight
items.body_markdown: The preview container for the showroom site was recycled at 02:14 and came back healthy. No action needed unless the preview URL is still failing.
